tests.title: Record / replay: the same input recording reproduces the same path

checks.name: recorded run: speed at the wall
recorded run: broken / plastic beams at the end
world snapshot size
checks.limit: all native arrays of the world, uncompressed

checks.name: snapshot restore reproduces the captured state
replay, recorded partition: end state bit-identical
replay, recorded partition: largest path deviation
replay at 8 substeps per frame: largest path deviation
replay at 8 substeps per frame: end state bit-identical
checks.limit: 1 = the frame partition does not change the run

checks.name: recording file round trip: end state bit-identical
respawn start after another history: settled state identical
respawn start after another history: replay bit-identical
respawn start: largest path deviation between the two replays
solver time of the recorded run (editor)

notes: Recorded 12.0 s: driver robot on a 3.5 m lane change at 55 km/h into a rigid wall 90 m ahead, frames of 25-40 substeps (seeded). Path = centre of mass at every recorded frame end; the 250 fps replay is compared where its frame ends coincide. Respawn runs: settled car at the origin, the second after a 2 s full-lock burnout elsewhere.
